mcp_tools.name: distribution_equipment_rating_condition_check
mcp_tools.title: Distribution equipment rating condition check
mcp_tools.description: Submit a distribution-equipment evidence manifest (ratings vs the current fault study with declared equipment ratings, MCC and switchgear specifics, transformer loading/temperature/paralleling records, condition-awareness and coordination/safety records); get a deterministic RATING_CONDITION_SOUND / RATING_CONDITION_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed rating-coverage, nameplate-loading, declared-temperature-limit and paralleling-match checks, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The distribution-equipment evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and equipment/transformer entry schemas).

ratings.description: Ratings-vs-fault-study evidence (study current, ratings verified against it).

equipment.description: Declared equipment entries: {id, interrupting_rating_ka, available_fault_current_ka, continuous_current_rating_a, load_current_a}.

transformers.description: Declared transformer entries: {id, nameplate_kva, load_kva, top_oil_temp_c, top_oil_limit_c, winding_temp_c, winding_limit_c, paralleled, vector_group_match, ratio_match, impedance_match}.

expect.notes: All boolean flags set to pass; equipment and transformer values are within safe limits. computed_spot_checks: CB-01 margin 10kA, TX-01 load 80% of nameplate.
